highlights_headline: The 4.157.1 servicing changes avoid unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors instead of destroying pools that may trigger a driver failure. Graphite also rejects further allocations through the abandoned handle. This vendor-specific workaround trades pool cleanup for safety; managed bindings are unchanged.
